candidate_status: unmerged frozen v5; archive publication only
claim_scope: Matched reserved c2/v5 development-host result, not competitor parity or leadership. Resource-only comparisons to reused v4 are requested-heap observations. Independent v4/v5 timing ratios do not establish source causality.

code_validation.full_log_diagnostic_scope: Original failed-command diagnostic text retained; recorded terminal 5/5 success authoritative
code_validation.native_source_binding: Source snapshot after native completion; instantaneous native source identity was not measured
code_validation.old_base_identity_scope: Raw base-identity.json is the v4 starting parent, not v5
code_validation.scope: Offline validation of actual logs, module bytes and receipts; no tests, WASM, codecs or builds executed
code_validation.x86_wasi_full_source_binding: Nine hashes measured before platform/full checks and unchanged after; match frozen primary v5

offline_scope: Archive bytes, source/blob/ELF/module hashes, recorded argv/exits/logs, per-call samples, deterministic statistics, caps and process wall intervals. No original absolute path is opened, and no codec/test/build/Git is run.

full_summary.host_scope: Fixed development host reserved at original collector task boundary; resource/control builds and validation complete before start; no other codec/test/compiler in measured slots.
full_summary.ratio_direction: current elapsed / exact-old elapsed; values above one mean current is slower
full_summary.statistics_scope: Descriptive paired bootstrap, 20000 draws, 95 percent percentile interval, stratified by AB/BA. Matrix resamples shared primary-round blocks. Small sample on a non-quiet host; not an acceptance gate or an industry ranking.
full_summary.timer_scope: Continuous per-call allocating public encode, length mix and free; one encode/free warmup per process; complete SHA256/cross-library decode initial_wire_only outside timing.
full_summary.wire_identity_scope: All initial complete wires pinned-decoder verified before sampling; each sample process's initial wire SHA matches preflight. Timed output identity is checked by length/mix only, with no SHA inside the continuous encode/free timer.

primary.label: v5
primary.scope: Reserved fixed development-host c2 versus unmerged frozen v5; 90 matched AB/BA pairs. Original reducer prose retained raw; reservation receipts determine the actual window. Initial complete wires and recorded pinned-decode receipts verified offline; timed outputs have length/mix checks only. No codec is executed by this verifier.

public_controls.scope: All per-call raw ns retained; arithmetic process means; six paired ratios per control; 20000 order-stratified draws. Initial wires only; no decoder run offline.

reservation.scope: Recorded pidfd-targeted reservation and wall intervals, not independent host-wide scheduler tracing
reservation.startup_001_scope: SIGSTOP acknowledgement race before quiet_start; finally CONT recorded; no timed sample

resources.scope: Existing force_moving_growth=true whole-operation requested heap; profile/tracker peaks and free ledgers. Excludes native RSS, stack, physical traffic, input/oracle/decode/report allocations, bookkeeping and remap internal transients. Resource throughput not measured; baseline/v4 reused without rerun.

sources.baseline_source_reconstruction: Full v5 filesystem for equal c2 blobs plus explicit c2 delta; Git not invoked
